briefdescription.para: Unified error taxonomy and diagnostic primitives for the Updates module.

detaileddescription.para:
1.0.0
1.8.1 (Q3 2026)
This header defines:
Error codes in the [7400-7499] range
Root cause classification
Severity levels and structured error context
Machine-parseable error taxonomy

These error codes are reserved for Updates module diagnostics only. Other modules must use their own ranges.
